title: Headless TTW Galaxy News Radio (MQ02): from Three Dog's task (MQ01 200, MQ02 10) through the Museum of Technology's Virgo II dish and the Washington Monument relay back to Three Dog (stage 200, completed; MQ03 started)

actions.text: Start: MQ01 at its last stage before Three Dog's task (given: running at 150, as ttw-mq01-following-in-his-footsteps leaves it before the conversation; CG04 completed; bInDCWasteland as TTWStart's Capital choice sets it). Three Dog's answer that takes the task (MQ01ThreeDogQuestYes, 0x0A03E5B6) is said as the stand-in for the end of that chain: its end script gives the Virgo II note and sets MQ01 200 and MQ02 10 (the password note, map markers).
The player walks to the Museum of Technology (MQ02QuestScript: within 400 units of MQ02MuseumMarker, stage 20); the Mall's super mutants on the way are the pilot's fights.
In the museum the player takes the Virgo II dish: MQ02VirgoIIDishScript's message, Take (button 0), stage 30.

Into the Washington Monument (MQ02QuestScript: in WashingtonMonument01, stage 40), up to the relay; the player fits the dish (MQ02RelayBeforeScript's message, button 0: the dish is removed, GNR broadcasts again, stage 50).

Up to the relay: no door joins WashingtonMonument01 and the top (worldspace WashMonTop). The lobby's elevator car has a scripted panel [observed, Fallout3.esm]: WashingMonumentElevatorInsidePanel (WashingtonMonumentElevatorLowerLevelInnerScript) closes the car, plays the ride and, the animations over, runs player.MoveTo MQ02ElevatorExit at the top. (Its LowerLevelOuterScript button is the car door's switch and is not in the lobby's space.)

actions.label: at the monument's top after the elevator

actions.text: Back to GNR Studios: Three Dog thanks the player and tells about Dad and Rivet City; the goodbye (MQ02ThreeDogCT04's end script: the photo note, stage 200 completes MQ02 and sets MQ03 0).
Down again: the top's elevator control (MQ02ElevatorControlTopOutsideScript) runs player.MoveTo MQ02ElevatorEntrance in the lobby [observed, Fallout3.esm].
